description: Fictional dual-camera reference kit. Two simulated camera sensors observe one reference chart under several illuminations; a deliberately wrong 'foreign' camera is included as a negative control for cross-camera transfer.
simulation_note: Every image in this kit is a SIMULATED response, not a photograph. The manifest marks each file's role; see 'simulation_models' in this file for the exact effects applied.
simulation_models: camera colour mixing: fixed 3x3 matrix in linear light (camera_profiles[*].matrix)
illumination + white balance: per-channel diagonal gain (illuminations[*].gains)
sensor noise: seeded Gaussian, sigma per camera
black level: linear offset added before clipping
patches: matte, no texture; chart border and background are synthetic

cam_a.label: Camera A (coarse colour filter, mild cross-talk)

foreign_cam.label: Foreign camera (deliberately far from A and B; negative control)

dim.label: Underexposed capture of the same neutral light

acceptance.description: A cross-camera rebuild must satisfy all checks; the verifier exits non-zero otherwise.
